title: ADA Ramps

onscreen_lines.note: Provide a temporary, modular ADA-compliant ramp system suitable for use during District commencement ceremonies. Preferred Specs Material: Aluminum or equivalent corrosion-resistant construction suitable for outdoor use. Surface: Stable, firm, and slip-resistant walking surface suitable for outdoor use, such as Geck Grip Raised Rib Tread. Usable Width: Minimum 48 inches and maximum 52 inches clear between handrails or other obstructions. Rise: Configuration shall accommodate a 30-inch vertical elevation while maintaining the required maximum running slope and complying with applicable accessibility requirements. Running Slope: Maximum 1:12 (8.33%). Cross Slope: Maximum 1:48 (2.08%). Capacity: Minimum load capacity of 100 lbs. per square foot (PSF). Length: Approximately 37 feet of total ramp system length, or an equivalent modular configuration capable of accommodating the required elevation while maintaining applicable accessibility requirements. Handrails: Handrails shall be provided on both sides of ramp runs as required by applicable accessibility standards. Handrail gripping surfaces shall be 34 to 38 inches above the ramp surface. Edge Protection: Edge protection shall be provided as required by applicable accessibility standards. Landings: Level landings shall be provided as required by applicable accessibility standards, including at the top and bottom of ramp runs and at changes in direction. Configuration: Modular and reconfigurable construction preferred. Use: System shall be suitable for repeated assembly, disassembly, storage, and outdoor use. Completeness: Vendor shall provide all components necessary for a complete, safe, and functional ramp system. Compliance: Proposed system shall comply with all applicable federal, state, and local accessibility, safety, and building code requirements. Alternate Products: Alternate products meeting or exceeding the stated performance, safety, accessibility, and functional requirements may be considered subject to the District's prior written approval as specified in this RFB.
